LanguageData.RP_Set_Medical_Desc: Doctors charge a fee per treatment: the patient's wallet pays first, and any shortfall is covered by the digital treasury's health insurance. Medical income flows back to the treasury.
LanguageData.RP_Set_PawnTrade_HitPerSkill: Hit chance per Intellectual skill point: {0}%
LanguageData.RP_Set_Loot_KillerShare: Killer's share: {0}% (the rest goes to the treasury)
LanguageData.RP_Set_Escrow_Desc: RimPay offers digital asset escrow: escrowed assets no longer count toward raid threat points, while the colony's real wealth stays unchanged. Silver held in the digital treasury is already physically hidden and needs no escrow.
LanguageData.RP_Set_Escrow_BuildingDesc: Colony building wealth (including floors) is held as national reserves and no longer counts toward raid threat points.
LanguageData.RP_Set_Escrow_EquipmentDesc: Weapons, apparel, and cargo carried by pawns/animals no longer count toward raid threat points; pawn and mechanoid body value is unaffected.
LanguageData.RP_Set_RimSim_Desc: Requires RimSimManagementFramework. If not installed, the features below sleep automatically (regardless of mod load order).
LanguageData.RP_Set_RimSim_EnableDesc: Checkout discounts + shop income automatically deposited into the digital treasury. Requires RimSimManagementFramework.
LanguageData.RP_Set_RimSim_TreasuryRatio: Share of shop income to treasury: {0}%
LanguageData.RP_Set_RimSim_DeviceDiscount: Digital ecosystem discount (wearing RimDigitalLife devices): customers pay -{0}%
LanguageData.RP_Set_RimSim_QuantumDiscount: Quantum net tier discount (a colonist subscribes to QuantumNet): customers pay -{0}%
LanguageData.RP_Set_RimMarket_Desc: Requires RimMarket. If not installed, the features below sleep automatically (regardless of mod load order).
LanguageData.RP_Set_RimMarket_EnableDesc: Pawns spending at RimMarket pay with their digital wallet first; any shortfall is covered by physical silver on hand.
LanguageData.RP_Set_NpcWallet_Desc: Randomly generates digital wallet balances for visiting non-player faction pawns based on faction tech level, for use in consumption integrations.
LanguageData.RP_Set_NpcWallet_EnableDesc: At each daily settlement, visiting pawns on the map receive a one-time randomized starting balance; pawns that already have funds are skipped.
LanguageData.RP_Set_Bunny_Desc: Requires Bunnygirl Race. If not installed, the features below sleep automatically (regardless of mod load order).
LanguageData.RP_Set_Bunny_EnableDesc: Bunnygirl pocket money and casino wins/losses are tracked in their digital wallet, preventing double counting.
LanguageData.RP_Set_Hospitality_Desc: Requires Hospitality. If not installed, the features below sleep automatically (regardless of mod load order).
LanguageData.RP_Set_Hospitality_EnableDesc: Guest lodging/shopping/food purchases are charged to their digital wallet, with income flowing back to the colony.
LanguageData.RP_Set_RimStock_Desc: Requires RimStock. If not installed, the features below sleep automatically (regardless of mod load order). RimStock's broker market is called the "Earth market" — it is separate from RimPay's own RimWorld stock market, and the two never interact.
LanguageData.RP_Set_RimStock_EnableDesc: Depositing funds at the RimStock broker automatically deducts the matching digital silver from the RimPay digital treasury.
LanguageData.RP_AI_P2Promo1: [Recommended] Register and use the Player2 app to enjoy all AI features for free!
LanguageData.RP_AI_P2Promo2: Player2 is a free local desktop app with no API key needed; if it is installed and running, just tick the Player2 config to use it.
LanguageData.RP_AI_P2Promo3: Ticked configs are tried top-to-bottom in list order; on failure or quota exhaustion the next one takes over automatically.
LanguageData.RP_AI_EnableDesc: When enabled, each day's economic variables are randomized by AI; if every config fails, it automatically falls back to built-in randomness.

LanguageData.RP_AI_LiveDesc: Shows the economic values the AI has generated and applied right now, to verify the AI is actually in control.
LanguageData.RP_AI_ForceBtn: Request AI Economy Data Now (Force Request)
LanguageData.RP_AI_ForceDesc: The button above bypasses the once-per-day limit and makes the AI generate a fresh set of values shown above — handy for verifying the connection and AI control.

LanguageData.RP_AI_RimTalkCastDesc: After the AI generates each daily financial event, a pawn chats about it via RimTalk. Requires RimTalk installed and enabled.
LanguageData.RP_AI_JsonDesc: This JSON tells the AI which economic variables to return each day; edit freely, and restore defaults anytime if you break it.
LanguageData.RP_AI_CfgP2Hint: Player2 local service: no API key needed — just install and run Player2.
LanguageData.RP_AI_CfgLocalHint: Local model: fails automatically and falls through to the next config until Ollama is installed.

LanguageData.RP_Macro_CrashDesc: Panic selling hits the Rim stock market! Prices will plunge sharply with wild swings over the coming days, and traders will lowball your goods.
LanguageData.RP_Macro_GoldRushDesc: Gold rush sweeps the Rim! Enemies now carry far more digital silver, and the killer's share is richer too.
LanguageData.RP_Macro_ShortageDesc: Strained supply chains send prices soaring! Meal fees and living costs rise, and some goods see notable price swings.
LanguageData.RP_Macro_TechBoomDesc: Tech stocks surge! The market rallies broadly, trade prices climb, and traders will pay more for your goods.
LanguageData.RP_Macro_LetterBodySuffix: (This macro event lasts {0} more days, affecting stocks/trading/looting and other economic systems.)

LanguageData.RP_News_Tech_1: Solar flares knock multiple data centers offline; brief cloud communication outages trigger a sell-off.
LanguageData.RP_News_Tech_2: Breakthrough in microelectronics and nano-integrated circuits; the digital chip sector erupts across the board.
LanguageData.RP_News_Tech_3: Cheap assembled electronics flood underdeveloped settlements; thin-margin volume lifts valuations.
LanguageData.RP_News_Tech_4: Under investigation by the consumer protection association over rebranded chip assembly and false advertising.
LanguageData.RP_News_Tech_5: Top streamer's live sale is a smash hit! E-scooters and smart mobility lines sell out.
LanguageData.RP_News_Tech_6: Budget commuter scooters spread quickly across settlements; young pioneer crowds snap them up.
LanguageData.RP_News_Tech_7: Motor controller supply chain delays stretch delivery times for some models.
LanguageData.RP_News_Tech_8: Flagship smart devices go viral in live sales; the galaxy's premium consumer-digital leader holds firm.
LanguageData.RP_News_Tech_9: New-generation smartwatches and terminals launch; ecosystem subscription revenue hits a record share.
LanguageData.RP_News_Tech_10: Slowing hardware iterations leave investors on the fence; the stock consolidates short-term.
LanguageData.RP_News_Tech_11: Digital ecosystem synergies shine; software service add-on business is booming.
LanguageData.RP_News_Tech_12: Rising core chip material costs squeeze hardware margins for now.
LanguageData.RP_News_Faction_1: Raid on the colony ends in failure and a fierce counterattack; the loss of elite forces sparks a market sell-off.
LanguageData.RP_News_Faction_2: Completes a bulk goods settlement worth thousands of silver with the colony; bilateral trade sentiment hits a quarterly high.
LanguageData.RP_News_Faction_3: Deepens its strategic alliance with the colony; cross-border tariff exemption passes the council.
LanguageData.RP_News_Faction_4: Expectations of eased border tensions rise; defense friction costs come under control.
LanguageData.RP_News_Faction_5: Geopolitical friction escalates; blocked border trade routes sour business expectations.
LanguageData.RP_News_Faction_6: Seasonal tax collection wraps up with a fiscal surplus that beats market expectations.
LanguageData.RP_News_Faction_7: Galactic inflation and high resupply costs leave the quarterly report below expectations.
LanguageData.RP_News_Quantum_1: A powerful magnetic starlink storm strikes! Low-orbit relay links drop en masse; emergency comm maintenance underway.
LanguageData.RP_News_Quantum_2: CyberBazaar's mid-year gala kicks off; virtual shopping and digital asset trade volumes smash all-time records.
LanguageData.RP_News_Quantum_3: Gravity-gradient remote sensing radar fully calibrated; discovery of ultra-grade rich ore ignites a prospecting rush.
LanguageData.RP_News_Quantum_4: Concurrent compute load hits bandwidth limits; queued cloud tasks trigger customer complaints.
LanguageData.RP_News_Quantum_5: Quantum-encrypted channel expansion delivered on schedule; enterprise secure comms protocol sees wide adoption.
LanguageData.RP_News_Quantum_6: Microwave relay antenna arrays undergo routine maintenance; regional network throughput briefly limited.
LanguageData.RP_News_Agri_1: Extreme weather ravages hydroponic greenhouses; major grain-growing zones issue bulk harvest-loss warnings.
LanguageData.RP_News_Agri_2: Breeding breakthrough in high-stress hydroponic crops sends bulk grain spot prices and volumes higher.
LanguageData.RP_News_Agri_3: Seasonal bumper harvest delivery; deep-space grain reserve orders exceed expectations.
LanguageData.RP_News_Agri_4: Agri-nutrient solution raw materials get pricier, squeezing hydroponic profit margins.
LanguageData.RP_News_Ranch_1: An extreme cold snap sweeps the continent! Demand for warm purebred muffalo fur and meat skyrockets.
LanguageData.RP_News_Ranch_2: Harsh weather and fodder shortage limit livestock slaughter; the ranch supply chain strains.
LanguageData.RP_News_Ranch_3: Purebred muffalo breeding rates improve sharply; premium meat orders are fully booked.
LanguageData.RP_News_Ranch_4: Feed transport cycles drag on; livestock processing profits narrow slightly.
LanguageData.RP_News_Arms_1: Outbreaks of fighting trigger emergency orders for heavy point-defense weaponry; defense stocks surge across the board!
LanguageData.RP_News_Arms_2: High-energy electromagnetic weapons and composite armor patents pass military validation; defense procurement is booked solid.
LanguageData.RP_News_Arms_3: Settlement fortification upgrades drive robust demand for positional defense equipment.
LanguageData.RP_News_Arms_4: Calls for localized ceasefires grow; expendable ammunition procurement dips short-term.
LanguageData.RP_News_Mining_1: Intense geomagnetic disturbances distort deep geological survey radar; mining projects stall.
LanguageData.RP_News_Mining_2: Deep geothermal nuclear fission research lands; heavy-industry high-energy mining accelerates across the board.
LanguageData.RP_News_Mining_3: High-grade uranium ore is tight in spot markets; heavy-industry energy demand lifts mining valuations.
LanguageData.RP_News_Mining_4: Heavy drill bit wear runs high; above-expected mining costs cause short-term swings.
LanguageData.RP_News_ECom_1: A top streamer's single session sets a sales record; the cross-galaxy orbital e-commerce supply chain runs at full capacity!
LanguageData.RP_News_ECom_2: The CyberBazaar digital mega-sale ignites; galaxy-wide online retail order volumes break all records!
LanguageData.RP_News_ECom_3: Its own orbital freight shuttle fleet finishes expansion; next-day fulfillment hits a new high.
LanguageData.RP_News_ECom_4: Rising energy costs for long-haul galactic freight squeeze e-commerce delivery margins.
LanguageData.RP_News_Ent_1: The streamer is live and hot; RimEdge entertainment app activity peaks for the day.
LanguageData.RP_News_Ent_2: The year's blockbuster handheld title launches to acclaim; cartridge and digital download numbers both set records.
LanguageData.RP_News_Ent_3: Without a hit exclusive to lean on, hardware sales enter a cyclical off-season.
LanguageData.RP_News_Food_1: Global drought and famine stoke demand for safety! StarveMe long-life synthetic meal cans are snapped up across the galaxy.
LanguageData.RP_News_Food_2: Fast-paced pioneer meal packs sell strongly; the emergency food business posts steady revenue.
LanguageData.RP_News_Food_3: Ordinary food output is plentiful; demand for premium compressed food eases short-term.
LanguageData.RP_News_Medical_1: Breakthrough in advanced bionic nerve repair and bio-serum research; institutions upgrade target ratings across the board.
LanguageData.RP_News_Medical_2: Universal antibiotic and immune-booster orders are plentiful; the biopharma sector gains on volume.
LanguageData.RP_News_Medical_3: Clinical approval for a new gene drug slips; cautious money takes profits short-term.
LanguageData.RP_News_Media_1: Live chat heat breaks the internet; streaming ad and sponsorship revenue shares hit an all-time high!
LanguageData.RP_News_Media_2: An exclusive investigative exposé sparks galaxy-wide debate; subscriber numbers explode.
LanguageData.RP_News_Media_3: Rim rumors trigger a public trust crisis; major sponsors trim their promo budgets.
LanguageData.RP_News_Sports_1: The interstellar extreme skateboard racing championship wraps up; co-branded merchandise and ticket revenue post strong results.
LanguageData.RP_News_Sports_2: A leading athlete withdraws after breaking a bone in training; viewership cools somewhat.
LanguageData.RP_News_Finance_1: Bullish hot money piles on leverage to grab chips; the speculative derivative fund surges on heavy volume!
LanguageData.RP_News_Finance_2: Highly leveraged positions face concentrated liquidation; bears pile on and trigger a stampede of sell orders.
LanguageData.RP_News_General_1: Fundamentals stay healthy; bulls defend the stock with orderly buying.
LanguageData.RP_News_General_2: Profit-takers cash out at highs; the stock pulls back slightly under short-term pressure.
LanguageData.RP_News_ShockBuy: A mysterious offshore consortium builds a big stake; institutional money buys in hard and lifts the price.
LanguageData.RP_News_ShockShort: A famed interstellar short seller publishes a bearish report, questioning inflated revenue in its quarterly statements.
LanguageData.RP_News_VolatileDefault: Wild intraday swings amid fierce battles between bulls and bears.
